purpose: Uso real 2026-10-07 «un top 3 peliculas de suspenso del 2026»: the words that ask for a ranked listing of several things (semantic.listing.listing_asked). Folded, without accents.
enumeration_purpose: Uso real v3 tanda 2 «dame 4 paises de sudamerica que no tengan salida al mar» → four, two of them with a coast; «dame 5 ideas de cena…» then «me tiraste menos» → «Solo te proporcioné dos recetas»: the words that ask for a counted list (semantic.listing.enumeration_asked), the classes that are open (always more to suggest: never checked against how many exist) and the first-person verbs with which a reply says how many it gave (semantic.listing.stated_given_count).
relative_given_purpose: Audit 2026-10-08 t4-c02-2 «me tiraste una lista enorme» after three titles → «Lo siento, te di más de lo que pediste»: the words with which a reply says it gave more or fewer than asked (semantic.listing.stated_given_relation), after a given verb.
dispute_purpose: Review r19 2026-10-09 (after «dame 5 ideas de cena» and five: «dame otras 5», «explícame la 5», «son 5 o 4?», «las 5 están buenas» were read as a dispute of the count): a message disputes the count of BAXY's last list when it says what the person asked («te pedí 5», «I asked for 5»), or denies the count («eso no son 5») followed by a number (dispute_said), or says what BAXY gave («me tiraste menos», «me diste como 7», «you gave me fewer») followed by a number or more/fewer (dispute_given) (semantic.listing.count_disputed). A message that asks for other or more items («dame otras 5», «5 más», «another 5») is a new request.
dispute_filler_purpose: Review 2 r19 2026-10-09 (after five ideas, «te pedí 5 vegetarianas», «me diste 5 con pollo y yo quería con carne», «no son 5 personas, son 6» and «te dije 5 minutos» were read as a dispute of the count and answered «ya eran 5»): the words that only carry a dispute of the count; any other word left in the message besides the claim, the count, more/fewer, a discourse word or the class asked is a condition or another thing said, and the message is no dispute of the count (semantic.listing._says_only_the_count). Folded, single words.
inline_list_purpose: Ronda 19 (r17 t3-c03 «Puedes probar con Among Us, Garry's Mod, Portal 2 o Minecraft…» for five asked; t3-c17 «…el nacionalismo, las alianzas europeas, el nacionalismo eslavo y el imperialismo»): a list written inline is counted only when a number was asked (semantic.listing.listed_items). The conjunction that joins its last item, the words after which its first item begins, and how many words an item may have.
series_purpose: Revisión 1 de la ronda 22 («Lo siento, no encontré libros y no puedo seguir.» read as three items told): a sentence opened by a series («Bestiario, Rayuela y Octaedro son libros…», semantic.listing.opening_series) names its items only when one of series_copulas follows its last item, and none of its items holds a word of series_negations.
inline_discourse_purpose: Review r19 2026-10-09 («Claro, puedes probar con Among Us, Garry's Mod, Portal 2, Terraria o Minecraft.» read as six items, the first «Claro»; «Sí, claro, lo abro y te aviso» as four): a segment of a sentence that is only one of these discourse words or interjections, folded and without punctuation, is no item of an inline list (semantic.listing._inline_items).
repeat_purpose: Ronda 22 (r18 t4-c02 «Bestiario, Rayuela y Rayuela», t2-c02 «leche de coco, leche de coco»): the words that join one thing said twice in a row (semantic.listing.duplicated_run), and the small words a title or a name may carry inside it (semantic.listing.title_only: «It Takes Two», «El Señor de los Anillos»).
figure_phrase_purpose: Ronda 24 (r23 t3-c17 t1 «dame 4 causas de la primera guerra mundial» → three: the item «El asesinato del archiduque Francisco Fernando en Sarajevo en 1914» went whole for its year): the words, folded, that open a phrase of time or place around a figure from memory («en 1914», «desde 1871», «in 1914»); the phrase goes and the item stays (semantic.listing.without_figure_phrase).
figure_range_purpose: Revisión 4 de la ronda 24 («dame 4 causas de la guerra que terminó en 1918» → «1. La guerra en Europa entre 1914 y 1918.» cut to «…en Europa y 1918»): the heads of a phrase between two terms and the words that join them; such a phrase goes whole with its second term, or the item is left as it was (semantic.listing.without_figure_phrase).
